original_title: Sherri Shepherd Bids “Bittersweet” Farewell Following Talk Show Conclusion: “Here Is To New Beginnings”
summary_en: Sherri Shepherd is bidding a “bittersweet” goodbye to her namesake syndicated talk show, which concluded its four-season run on Thursday. “Family!!!! Thank you so much for all of the love and support over these last 4 years. It was a bittersweet end to a life I got to know so well. But here is to […]
